Callout.Name: Missing Person Report
Callout.Message: Missing person report, last seen this morning.
Callout.Advisory: Adult male, no medical condition reported, on foot.

Script.Line: He walked out this morning and he has not come back.
He does not carry a phone. He never has.
That is his picture. That is the best one I have got.

Lines.Approach: Last seen this morning on foot. Family are out looking as well.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
